name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx with three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, generates self-signed TLS certificates, deploys fail2ban and UFW firewall rules, applies sysctl security hardening, and hardens SSH configuration.

name: cache
description: Installs and configures Memcached and Redis with password authentication, including a post-processing workaround for deprecated Redis configuration directives.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys a FastAPI Python application from GitHub, creates a Python virtual environment, provisions a PostgreSQL database and user, and registers a systemd service to run the application on port 8000.
